summary: Episodes 84-89 are six consecutive canon rows adapting PRINTED chapters 290-310 (vols 31-33) of the Vearn Palace endgame: Dai's second dragon crest and the reactor fight (84), reaching Vearn at the tower's summit (85), Vearn's recruitment offer / Avan vs Killvearn / the White Garden merge (86), Him's victory and Dai's double Douloura (87), Vearn's disappearance and Mistvearn unmasked (88), the Frozen-Time secret and Popp's Medroa (89). EVERY number below is PRINTED (tankobon 1-348) and the conversion is stated per row. THE NUMBERING FINDING OF THIS SUB-BLOCK: dragonquest.fandom's per-episode `adapted` field is ALREADY PRINTED in this range - N35's stored sourceShift `fandom: from 208 delta -1` does not hold here. Three independent legs prove it (see structure.notes): coco13.club's per-episode 'from TITLE to TITLE' ranges, Toei Animation's own per-episode arasuji, and dai.morisan3rd.site's per-CHAPTER summaries, whose chapter numbers are printed (its 290 = Makyu no Shinzo = en-WP's list 291 minus 1). Eps 85-87 carry the wave's flagged REORDER, and it is a genuine un-cross-cut in BOTH directions: the manga tells the three simultaneous battles (Dai vs Vearn / Avan vs Killvearn / White Garden vs Mistvearn) one after another, the anime interleaves them, so ep 85 pulls the White Garden halves of ch 299-300 FORWARD out of order and ep 87 plays the Dai-vs-Vearn half of ch 299 BACKWARD, after ch 301-302 (coco13 documents both moves in words). No filler, no mixed: every row is a faithful adaptation with cuts and small studio additions only (faithfulness clause, T28).

Soryumon). A10: ch 290's opening panels closed ep 83, but ep 84 carries the chapter's substance, so START stays 290; coco13 states the range as 'Makyu no Shinzo to Hoero! Soryumon'. END 293 is whole - both ep-85 sources start ep 85 on 294. v31 = printed 285-294.

Daimao Baan o nomikonda' = 304's first beat), so ep 87's share of 304 is a closing flash and ep 88 STARTS on 304 and owns it. coco13 agrees on both edges (301 -> 303). v32.

annotations.note: Faithfulness clause (T28): cuts only - Goroa's Makai folk-tale of the 'immortal swordsman' is dropped, Vearn's long explanation of the Soryumon is heavily trimmed, and Leona's clothes are far less ruined than in the manga (coco13's ep-84 change list). Canon stands.

Faithfulness clause (T28): the Dai/Vearn and Mistvearn fights are EXPANDED beyond the manga's pages (an arrow version of Daichizan, Popp's Begirama and Merazoma, Maam's spinning bird kick) - studio-made beats inside adapted chapters, noted, never weighed toward mixed (coco13's ep-85 change list).

The anime un-cross-cuts in reverse: the manga tells the three simultaneous battles one after another, the anime interleaves them, so the White Garden half of ch 299 (Larhart's blows failing) and the opening of ch 300 (Him's rescue) are pulled FORWARD into ep 85 - in the manga Him's rescue comes only after Vearn's Kaiser-Phoenix double attack (coco13, ep 85: 'jikeiretsu ga henko sare, gensaku yori hayai dankai de Him ga tojo'; ep 86: 'Baan-sen, Mistbaan-sen, Killbaan-sen ga gensaku to chigai, doji shinko de egakarete iru') - and the rest of both chapters runs in ep 86. Ep 86's START 297 is therefore a back-jump behind ep 85's furthest pages.

Faithfulness clause (T28): studio additions inside adapted chapters - the Bengarna scenes are cut in when Vearn warns Dai he will be persecuted, a montage of the people Dai has met is added to his decision, and Popp gains a line when Him's light aura is revealed (coco13's ep-86 change list).

Ch 301 Hakugin no Moi!! straddles eps 86/87: ep 86 has only its opening (Him's first light-aura blows), ep 87 carries the bulk and the settlement. The END advances onto it under the wave-14 unproven-tail convention (no page count, no teaser wording); coco13 bounds ep 86 at ch 300 instead - flagged.

Ch 299 Fuan na Yusei is split NON-CONTIGUOUSLY and out of order: its White Garden half ran in eps 85-86, and its Dai-vs-Vearn half (Dai's uneasy advantage, Vearn's Kaiser Phoenix + Komma-no-Tsue simultaneous attack) is played in ep 87 AFTER ch 301-302 - a back-jump inside the episode, per Toei's paragraph order against morisan3rd's per-chapter content.

A47 tail: ep 87 closes on the second Douloura being fired (ch 303's last beat) and shows at most the impact flash of ch 304 Daimao Kiyu...!!; ep 88 STARTS on 304 and owns it, so ep 87's END stays 303.

Faithfulness clause (T28): staging changes and one added beat inside adapted chapters - Mistvearn holds Larhart's face while landing the body blow (the manga simply blows him away), and Larhart, who left before Medroa existed, is given a short beat of not understanding what everyone is hoping for (coco13's ep-88 change list).

Faithfulness clause (T28): an added reaction (Brokeena surprised that Him and Larhart are combatants) and cosmetic substitutions inside Brokeena's flashback - Papirus and Sabertiger become Hikuidori and Killer Panther, and Matriv's spells are named (Begirama, Bagicross) where the manga leaves them generic (coco13's ep-89 change list).

Ch 310 Senritsu no Jijitsu...!!! straddles eps 89/90: ep 89 takes its first third (the Phoenix Wing deflection, Popp and Brokeena consumed), ep 90 the remainder (Hyunckel's deduction that Mistvearn is Vearn himself, Killvearn's arrival). Not an A47 hold - the tail is the episode's climax and a major plot beat, not a scrap.
